title: 第007章 魂力武技第008章 剑冢地
content_zh:
而在此时的夜幕下……
齐家，大厅！
此地汇聚着齐家家主齐刀以及齐长剑等长老，但在地面之上则放着一具尸体，使得氛围一片凝重。
“叶家叶炎！”
“竟敢杀害我儿？”
齐刀的眼眸赤红，充斥着杀意。
“家主息怒，只怪老夫没能护住少爷！”齐长剑跪在地上开口。
齐刀深吸了一口气道：“此事不怪你，谁能想到叶炎竟也达到了九重筑体境？我儿定是小觑了他方才被其斩杀。”
“但这笔账，叶家迟早要还的。”
“而且……不止叶炎一人要还！”
“杀我儿一人，我让他们叶家所有少年全部陪葬。”
轰！
在这等杀意之下，齐家众长老噤若寒蝉。
“灵台剑冢地开启，叶家也要前往吧？此次我要让叶家少年有去无回！”齐刀神色冷凝。
但齐家大长老却是上前道：“家主，灵台剑冢地……叶龙定然跟随，他的实力不可忽视……”
齐刀冷笑：“我何时说过我齐家要与叶龙一战？何况叶啸天的名字毕竟还写在苍云圣碑之上，我齐家怎能动手？”
“这……”齐家众长老愕然。
齐刀再道：“你们可别忘了，到了真正的剑冢地，我等皆是无法踏入，那里的阵法只让十八岁以下的少年进入。”
齐家大长老蹙眉：“我齐家之内，齐山少爷天赋卓绝，虽早已达到了结丹境，但终究十九岁了……至于我齐家其他的少年……很难在剑冢地内将叶家之人诛杀。”
叶家内，十八岁的少年不少！

他们的实力可也是不弱。
齐山自可横扫一切，但却无法进入啊。
“杀他们，何须我齐家少年？”
“用我齐家令牌，置信方家家主，告诉他……若能诛杀叶家少年我齐家将拿出一件下阶灵器！”
“至于叶炎，我齐家人亲自来杀！”
闻言，众长老眼眸猛然一亮。
方家在这苍云城势力也极为不弱，而且方家家主的儿子方阐不满十八岁，如今已是达到了八重凝气境，何况方家中还有着两位七重凝气境的少年。
“至于叶家，叶童、叶然也只是六重或者七重凝气境吧？”
“若真的有所变故，我齐家之内，也有七重凝气境界的少年！”
“何况，灵器选择天赋强大者，可惜我儿齐山年龄超了，或许要便宜方家了，到那时……手持灵器之下，叶家少年岂能活？”
齐刀话语落下，齐家长老顿时点了点头。
虽说苍云圣碑上有叶啸天的名字，但这等剑冢地内的争夺，苍云圣碑内的圣威可管不着。
“到时候，叶家少年皆死，我倒是要看看叶龙他们的脸色……”
“哼！”
齐山冷嗤。
为了给齐水报仇，拿出一件灵器虽然肉疼但那又如何？
一月之后叶家灭了，叶家的一切资产显然会落入齐家之中，何况……云家大喜那齐家将彻底腾飞。
多少家族想要绑上云家这大腿还没机会！
……
在齐家谋划之时，叶炎仍在剑内空间世界中。

此时，在他目光之下，一排排书架矗立，这古老的书架上放着各种古籍。
只是，每一排书架，都似有着一道屏障。
前面第一排书架，叶炎可观，但想要去往第二排书架时，却是被阻拦了下来。
这让叶炎也是一叹，看来依照如今他的力量，也只能观看第一排书架上的武技、术法等。
content_en:
And under the night at this time...
Qijia, hall!
Elders such as the head of the Qi family, Qi Dao and Qi Changjian, gathered here, but there was a corpse on the ground, making the atmosphere solemn.
"Ye Family Ye Yan!"
"How dare you kill my son?"
Qi Dao's eyes were red and filled with murderous intent.
"Master, calm down, it's my fault that I failed to protect the young master!" Qi Changjian knelt on the ground and spoke.
Qi Dao took a deep breath and said: "I don't blame you for this matter. Who would have thought that Ye Yan has reached the ninth level of body building? My son must have underestimated him before he was killed."
"But the Ye family will have to pay this debt sooner or later."
"And... Ye Yan is not the only one who wants to pay back!"
"Kill one of my sons, and I will bury all the young men of their Ye family with him."
Boom!
Under such murderous intent, the elders of the Qi family remained silent.
"The Lingtai Sword Tomb has been opened. The Ye family will also go there, right? This time I want to make sure that the young Ye family never returns!" Qi Dao's expression was condensed.
But the eldest elder of the Qi family stepped forward and said: "Master, the Lingtai Sword Tomb... Ye Long will definitely follow, his strength cannot be ignored..."
Qi Dao sneered: "When did I say that my Qi family wanted to fight Ye Long? Besides, after all, Ye Xiaotian's name is still written on the Cangyun Holy Monument, how could my Qi family take action?"
"This..." The elders of the Qi family were stunned.
Qi Dao said again: "Don't forget that when we get to the real Sword Tomb, we will not be able to step into it. The formation there only allows young people under the age of eighteen to enter."
The eldest elder of the Qi family frowned: "In our Qi family, Young Master Qi Shan is extremely talented. Although he has already reached the Dan Formation realm, he is still nineteen years old... As for the other young men in my Qi family... it is difficult to kill the Ye family in the Sword Tomb."
There are many eighteen-year-old boys in the Ye family!
Their strength is not weak either.
Qishan can sweep everything, but it cannot enter.
"Why should I, the young man of Qi family, kill them?"
"Use my Qi family's token to trust the head of the Fang family and tell him...if I can kill the young man from the Ye family, my Qi family will bring out a lower-level spiritual weapon!"
"As for Ye Yan, my whole family will come to kill him personally!"
Hearing this, the elders' eyes suddenly lit up.
The Fang family is extremely powerful in Cangyun City, and the son of the head of the Fang family, Fang Chan, is less than eighteen years old and has now reached the eighth level of Qi Condensation. What's more, there are two teenagers in the Fang family who are at the seventh level of Qi Condensation.
"As for the Ye family, Ye Tong and Ye Ran are only at the sixth or seventh level of Qi Condensation, right?"
"If something happens, there will also be a young man at the seventh level of Qi Condensation in my Qi family!"
"What's more, the spiritual weapon chooses those with strong talents. Unfortunately, my son Qi Shan is over the age. He may be able to take advantage of the Fang family. By then... how can the young man of the Ye family survive with the spiritual weapon in hand?"
After Qi Dao finished speaking, the elders of the Qi family nodded immediately.
Although Ye Xiaotian's name is on the Cangyun Holy Monument, the Holy Power in the Cangyun Holy Monument has no control over the competition within the Sword Tomb.
"When the time comes, all the young men of the Ye family will die. I want to see the faces of Ye Long and others..."
"Hmph!"
Qi Shan sneered coldly.
In order to avenge Qi Shui, taking out a spiritual weapon may hurt my body, but so what?
After one month, the Ye family will be destroyed, and all the assets of the Ye family will obviously fall into the Qi family. What's more... the Yun family is very happy that the Qi family will take off completely.
How many families want to tie up the Yun family but haven't had the chance!
…
While the Qi family was planning, Ye Yan was still in the spatial world within the sword.
At this time, under his gaze, rows of bookshelves stood. Various ancient books were placed on these ancient bookshelves.
However, every row of bookshelves seems to have a barrier.
Ye Yan looked at the first row of bookshelves in front of him, but when he wanted to go to the second row of bookshelves, he was blocked.
This made Ye Yan sigh. It seems that with his current strength, he can only watch the martial arts, techniques, etc. on the first row of bookshelves.
